scalars.scalar_value: Experience working as a veterinary assistant in a small animal hospital with the skill to assist in the performance of veterinary medical treatments and procedures.

items.item_text: Experience working as a veterinary assistant in a small animal hospital with the skill to assist in the performance of veterinary medical treatments and procedures.
Experience using safe animal handling and restraint techniques for a wide variety of patients.

Under supervision of the Small Animal Nursing supervisor, clean, disinfect, sanitize and stock assigned areas according to established protocols. Monitor and record patient vital functions; maintain supply inventory and equipment; perform feeding, hospitalization and discharge procedures according to protocol.
This position ends 4 months from date of hire with the possibility of extension.
Education in veterinary technology or veterinary science.
Knowledge of common hospital pathogens and methods of disinfection along with knowledge of medical terminology and disease processes.
